---
title: "A missing abstraction"
date: 2026-11-06
description: "Reading the SCF code after Milestone 2a, Mads-Peter finds the mixing scheme hard-coded in the solver. The fix leads to an audit of the same pattern elsewhere."
---

After Milestone 2a was validated, Mads-Peter read some of the code and found
that the Anderson mixing scheme was written into the fixed-point solver, with
a class that held its parameters but not the method. This is the kind of thing
`CLAUDE.md` asks the architecture to avoid, and the tests had no way to catch
it.

Claude makes the change and shows that results are bitwise unchanged.
Mads-Peter then asks for the same check across the rest of the package, with
proposals before any code changes. Of the six places Claude finds, it
recommends changing three and leaving three for the milestones that need
them.

What came of it: the entries "Mixing behind a protocol" and "SCF extension
points" in the [engineering log](../engineering/engineering_log.qmd).
